sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal
This petition has been filed for seeking directions for protection of life and property of the petitioner and for transfer of the investigation to any other Investigating Agency.
The petitioner has alleged certain issues against respondent No.3/IO in the said FIR No.215/2018 registered under Sections 420/467/468/471/34 IPC at PS Jagatpuri.
He states that the basic issue between the parties are civil in nature and various suits have been filed by the parties and the IO has been unnecessarily targeted.
Ld. ASC will file a Status Report in this regard before the next date of hearing.

4. List on 15.09.2023.
